name: Criteria Scoring Method Design
methodology_notes: Candidate scores are experimental and are not final suitability scores.
5th and 95th percentiles are statistical comparison limits, not official UDA rules.
C3 increasing and decreasing directions are both tested without selecting one.
C5 remains unscored until its role is academically justified.
The 500m C2/C3 measurements remain provisional spatial-scale choices.
No AHP weights, final suitability scores or zoning restrictions were applied.
The frozen Step 16B input is unchanged.
